title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.30842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans play a vital role at every stage of AI development, from data collection and curation to model development and evaluation. However, humans often disagree with each other and sometimes with themselves over time. It is essential to take disagreement into account when building human-centered AI systems, especially in domains where it is prevalent, such as AI safety, content moderation, or sentiment analysis. Disagreement often arises from subjective human opinion and can vary with one's identity, beliefs, and social environment. Despite this, current LLM evaluation approaches frequently rely on aggregating labels (often via plurality voting) to represent consensus, thereby obscuring minority perspectives. By failing to account for human disagreement, these evaluation methods contribute to the reproducibility crisis in AI. translated_title: 论文提案：面向可复现机器学习评估与AI对齐的以人为中心和视角感知框架
translated_abstract: 人类在AI发展的每个阶段都扮演着至关重要的角色，从数据收集和整理到模型开发和评估。然而，人类之间经常存在分歧，有时甚至会随时间与自己产生分歧。在构建以人为中心的AI系统时，必须将这种分歧考虑在内，尤其是在AI安全、内容审核或情感分析等分歧普遍存在的领域。分歧往往源于人类的主观意见，并可能因个人的身份、信仰和社会环境而异。尽管如此，当前的LLM评估方法通常依赖于聚合标签（通常通过多数投票）来代表共识，从而掩盖了少数群体的观点。由于未能考虑人类分歧，这些评估方法加剧了AI领域的可复现性危机。人类反馈对于确保AI系统与人类价值观保持一致也至关重要。为使这些系统值得信任……（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提案的核心创新是提出一个以人为中心且具备视角感知的框架，通过显式建模人类分歧而非简单聚合标签，来提升机器学习评估的可复现性并促进AI与人类价值观的对齐。
en_tdlr: This thesis proposal introduces a human-centered, perspective-aware framework that explicitly models human disagreement rather than aggregating labels, aiming to improve the reproducibility of ML evaluation and support AI alignment with human values.
